dataset: Periodic Labour Force Survey (annual/calendar public-use files)
what_to_get: Download every available household/person file, questionnaires, schedules, data dictionaries, estimation notes, and code lists for each wave. Highest priority: 2023-24 catalog 213 and 2025 catalog 284.
key_variables: education level and field; technical education; occupation NCO; industry NIC; usual/current status; unemployment; regular/casual/self-employment; wages; hours; social group; religion; gender; age; state/district; survey weights
model_use: Employment and earnings distributions for physicians, engineers, lawyers, nurses, pharmacists and alternate paths; unemployment/underemployment gates; pooling rare occupations
limitations: Questionnaire/design changed in 2025; keep pre-2025 and revamped 2025 models separate before harmonizing.

geography: India, state, NSS region, district where released, rural/urban
what_to_get: Download all levels, schedules, codebooks, multiplier files, and methodology for both waves.
key_variables: monthly per-capita consumption; detailed expenditure; household size; social group; religion; occupation; durable assets; free goods; geography; weights
model_use: Map American relative rank to Indian household-resource percentiles; coaching/tuition burden; affordability
limitations: Consumption is not income or wealth; use as primary welfare rank but retain separate wealth/debt models.

dataset: Comprehensive Modular Survey on Education (CMSE), NSS 80th Round
what_to_get: Download all person/household files plus questionnaire, data dictionary, multipliers and report.
key_variables: current attendance; institution type; course; educational expenses; private coaching participation and expenditure; scholarships; digital access; reasons for non-attendance
model_use: Current coaching-cost and participation distributions; education-path costs and dropout
limitations: First release; validate variable denominators and survey weights carefully.

dataset: Household Social Consumption: Education, NSS 75th Round
what_to_get: Download all 8 levels, questionnaires, layouts, multipliers, sample-design and instruction files.
key_variables: institution type; course; board/medium where available; all educational expenditure; preparation for higher/additional studies; scholarships; non-attendance; vocational/technical training
model_use: Pre-NEET-era/current comparison; tutoring and preparation expenses; alternative education routes
limitations: Older than current NEET market but exceptionally detailed; inflate costs and model structural change.

dataset: Debt and Investment Survey (AIDIS), NSS 77th Round
what_to_get: Download Visit 1 and Visit 2 files, schedules, asset/debt codebooks and multipliers.
key_variables: land; buildings; financial assets; durable assets; outstanding debt; loan source/purpose; household characteristics; social group
model_use: Private-seat affordability, borrowing capacity, catastrophic financing and wealth percentiles
limitations: Infrequent cross-section; not linked to NEET candidates.

what_to_get: Request household, household-member, women, men and GPS files for India. Download recode manuals and questionnaires too.
key_variables: asset wealth index; caste/social group; religion; education; school attendance; household structure; urbanity; district/cluster; health and mental-health-adjacent indicators
model_use: Synthetic household demographics and small-area wealth/context; family composition; state/district calibration
limitations: GPS access is separately reviewed and coordinates are displaced; NFHS lacks NEET outcomes.

what_to_get: Request same file families as NFHS-5, including GPS if approved.
key_variables: same core variables as NFHS-5
model_use: Pre/post context and trend validation; district harmonization
limitations: Questionnaire and district boundaries differ from NFHS-5.

dataset: India Human Development Survey I and II
what_to_get: Download ICPSR 22626 and 36151 in a preferred statistical format plus all linking, community, school, medical facility, household and individual files.
key_variables: household income and consumption; caste; religion; education; school type; fees; tutoring; occupation; wages; siblings; aspirations; health; panel IDs
model_use: Intergenerational mobility, family investment, sibling correlations, education and employment transitions
limitations: Old relative to current NEET; useful for structural priors rather than current rates.

eligibility: Create account and request microdata for all four waves; download questionnaires, coding designs and data descriptions immediately.
what_to_get: measured household income; consumption; assets; debt; savings; gold; labour participation; education and health spending; household profile
key_variables: Best potential joint income-consumption-wealth-debt source; longitudinal economic mobility and affordability
model_use: Current site does not state price or approval terms publicly; do not assume access until PRICE responds.
limitations: https://price360.in/data-center.php

what_to_get: Download person/household/activity-episode files, diaries, codebooks and multipliers for both waves.
key_variables: study time; paid work; unpaid domestic/care work; travel; leisure; gender/age/education/geography
model_use: Opportunity cost of repeat years, gendered study constraints, unpaid-work burden
limitations: Does not identify NEET aspirants; use as background-conditioned time-budget prior.

what_to_get: Download every level, schedules, codebooks, multipliers and report.
key_variables: digital access; migration; household characteristics; technical/vocational training; financial inclusion; transport/access indicators
model_use: Digital/transport access, migration and educational opportunity context
limitations: Pandemic-era collection; some outcomes unusual.

what_to_get: Download full microdata and documentation.
key_variables: education/health/digital/basic-services modules and household characteristics
model_use: Additional validation of access and household conditions
limitations: Check overlap/redundancy with MIS and HCES before modeling.

dataset: Annual Survey of Unincorporated Sector Enterprises (ASUSE)
what_to_get: Download enterprise and owner files, schedules, codebooks, weights and reports for all available recent waves.
key_variables: receipts, expenses, gross value added, employment, ownership, industry, location
model_use: Family-business and informal/self-employment alternative paths; household opportunity costs
limitations: Enterprise survey, not household panel; matching to synthetic families is indirect.

dataset: Household Social Consumption: Health, NSS 75th Round
what_to_get: Download all levels and documentation.
key_variables: hospitalization, outpatient care, medical spending, insurance, household characteristics
model_use: Family medical-shock burden and value of stable employment/insurance; context only
limitations: Not needed for first admission model; useful for quality-of-life extensions.

provider: Young Lives / UK Data Service or World Bank Microdata
dataset: Young Lives India longitudinal cohorts and school surveys
eligibility: Register with host archive and accept terms
what_to_get: Download all India child, household, community, school-survey and constructed panel files.
key_variables: cognitive scores; aspirations; household poverty; caste; parental education; schooling; fees; time use; psychosocial measures; transitions to work
model_use: Life-course, aspiration, sibling/family investment and psychosocial priors
limitations: Not nationally representative and concentrated in one regional sample.

provider: ICMR National Health Research Data Repository
access_type: Registration plus query/application; raw data often not released
what_to_get: Register, search holdings for adolescent stress, educational stress, mental health, medical students, and health-workforce studies; request permitted query extracts.
key_variables: study-specific
model_use: Mental-health exposure validation and medical training outcomes
limitations: Repository often returns approved analyses/query outputs rather than raw records.

dataset: NEET 2024 centre-wise marks derived from NTA
what_to_get: Download CSV/XLSX/Parquet version and metadata as a validation copy.
key_variables: centre ID, city/state, serial number, marks
model_use: Independent row-count/hash check of NTA reconstruction
limitations: Third-party derivative; preserve provenance and terms.

known_cost: ₹20 per column up to 200 lines; ₹10 each additional 200 lines; small modules ₹120-₹230/year
what_to_get: Do not buy whole large modules yet. Use pay-per-use for exact missing series: state domestic product per capita; employment; education enrollment/medical institutions; health workforce; consumption; price indices; income-tax aggregates.
key_variables: aggregate state/district time series
model_use: Deflators, state economic context, validation totals and historical trends
limitations: Terms restrict redistribution; record query definitions and save raw exports privately.

known_cost: 15-day: ₹5,664 incl. GST in India or $283 foreign, 10 tables; 30-day: ₹8,142 or $354, 30 tables
what_to_get: Before purchasing, identify exact tables that remain missing. Candidate targets: district domestic product/income, education by level/management, health workforce/facilities, labour/workforce, bank/credit, population. Buy 15-day plan only after table list is fixed.
key_variables: district aggregates
model_use: Small-area calibration for synthetic locality and state heterogeneity
limitations: Not unit records; limited downloads; much content may duplicate government sources.

known_cost: Current price not public; likely not small
what_to_get: First check university/employer/library access. Request academic quote and sample dictionaries for Income Pyramids, People of India, Consumption Pyramids, Aspirational India and employment modules.
key_variables: monthly household income/expenses; education and private-tuition fees; employment; demographics; panel transitions
model_use: Best potential high-frequency joint household income, tutoring expense and employment panel
limitations: Potentially expensive; licensing restrictive; do not purchase personally until quote and variable coverage are reviewed.

dataset: Custom applicant/matriculant data report for U.S. comparator
access_type: Request; custom reports may have fee
what_to_get: Request aggregate tables crossing family-income quintile, parental education, race/ethnicity, MCAT/GPA bands, applicant/matriculant status, medical-school ownership, debt and year.
key_variables: U.S. medical applicant background/admission/debt
model_use: U.S. comparison calibrated to similar family standing
limitations: AAMC may decline or charge; data are aggregate and governed by privacy policies.

known_cost: No data fee stated; institutional security/compliance costs
eligibility: Institutional affiliation, security plan, approved project
what_to_get: Apply only if public-use PowerStats cannot answer tuition/debt/family-income questions. Request NPSAS student-level restricted data.
key_variables: family income; aid; tuition; debt; institution; degree field; demographics
model_use: U.S. degree-cost and debt comparator
limitations: Not a quick personal download; institutional approvals and secure environment required.

what_to_get: Build extracts with household/person IDs, income, family income, occupation, education/field, employment, race/ethnicity, age, sex, geography, weights.
key_variables: income, occupation, education, employment, household context
model_use: U.S. synthetic-household and career distributions
limitations: PUMA is not ZIP/city; field-of-degree availability varies by year.

what_to_get: Build ASEC extracts for annual income and monthly extracts for employment transitions.
key_variables: income; employment/unemployment; occupation; education; household; race/ethnicity; weights
model_use: U.S. employment-risk and income comparator
limitations: Smaller than ACS for detailed occupations; pool years.

what_to_get: Download longitudinal education, employment, earnings, family background, debt, health and expectations variables.
key_variables: life-course panel
model_use: U.S. life-course transitions and consequences of delayed education
limitations: Cohorts are older than current applicants; use for structural validation.

dataset: NEET application/result database schema and anonymized socioeconomic-score tables
known_cost: ₹10 central application fee; possible copying/media charges
what_to_get: File the NTA template in docs/RTI_REQUEST_TEMPLATES.md. Ask first for schema/codebooks and existing anonymized exports/cross-tabs, not new analysis.
key_variables: mode of preparation; annual family income band; parents occupations/qualifications; category; gender; place of residence; addresses state/district; exam medium; school board/type/district; prior NEET appearance; score/rank
model_use: This is potentially the single most valuable missing joint dataset
limitations: Privacy/Section 8 issues likely; ask for severed aggregate or banded data and small-cell suppression. RTI covers existing records, not creation of a new statistical study.

geography: AIQ, central, deemed and other MCC quotas
what_to_get: Request existing electronic allotment/admission exports with year, round, rank, category/quota, domicile/state if held, course, college, management/ownership, allotment/joining/resignation status and gender if held.
key_variables: rank-to-seat mapping and actual joining
model_use: Admission likelihood, vacancy/non-joining, public/private/deemed paths
limitations: MCC does not cover all state-quota seats; privacy may require banding.

dataset: Historical medical-college capacity, ownership, fees, completion and attrition
what_to_get: Request existing electronic college-year files: sanctioned/recognized intake, ownership/management, fees if held, admitted students, examination pass-outs, internship completion, attrition, closures/recognition changes and stipends if held.
key_variables: seat supply; cost; completion
model_use: Medical capacity and probability of becoming a practicing doctor after admission
limitations: NMC may not hold fees or employment outcomes; ask it to identify the custodian where not held.

provider: State counselling/medical education authorities via state RTI portals
dataset: State applicant, merit, allotment, fee and joining records
geography: Each state; start Kerala, Gujarat, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra
what_to_get: Use generic state template, adapted to fields collected locally: domicile, state category, government-school quota, school board/medium, income/EWS, first/repeat status, rank, college/seat type, round and joining.
key_variables: state-specific admission joint distributions
model_use: Drill-down and validation of national independence assumptions
limitations: Central RTI portal cannot accept state-government requests. Separate requests and fee rules are required.

dataset: ASER household/school unit records or custom tabulations
access_type: Direct research request; access policy unclear
what_to_get: Request anonymized unit records or custom tables for Class 10-12 progression, science access, paid tuition/coaching, parental education/assets, gender/caste/state where collected.
key_variables: learning and school pipeline
model_use: Pre-NEET educational readiness and rural inequality
limitations: ASER mainly covers younger children and rural households; variable coverage differs by year.

provider: Major coaching providers and scholarship programs
what_to_get: Request program-level or anonymized candidate rows with baseline diagnostic score, program type/duration/fees/scholarship, prior attempts, school background, final NEET score/rank, and seat outcome. Providers: ALLEN, Aakash, Physics Wallah, Narayana, Motion, Resonance, public welfare/residential programs.
key_variables: coaching selection, score gain and admission outcome
model_use: Direct calibration of coaching effect and heterogeneity
limitations: Advertising success counts without enrollment denominators are not effect estimates; require full cohort denominators.
